newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Red Back Mining sees listing by end October.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Red Back Mining sees listing by end October.

text.p: West Australian exploration group Red Back Mining NL said on Thursday it expected to list on the Australian Stock Exchange by the end of October.

Redback's managing director Ross Ashton told Reuters the company hoped to raise A$5 million through the issue of 25 million shares at a price of 20 cents per share to fund exploration on nickel and gold projects in Western Australia's Yilgarn Shield region.
The exploration projects include four gold, two nickel and one nickel/gold properties.
Ashton said the company would spend A$2.55 million overall for exploration over the next two years.

At the key project, Irwin Hills, located 90 kilometres south-east of Laverton, Ashton said WMC Ltd can earn a 60 percent interest by funding nickel exploration through to a bankable feasubility study.
Ashton said WMC was targetting nickel sulphides similar to those found at its Kambalda mine.
